title: CollectionBatchImport
description: Batch wrapper for multiple collection records exchanged together. Each record is a complete collection record and is validated independently against the collection schema. Records can refer to other entities by identifier, such as a parent collection or member assets. The array length does not establish that the batch is complete. How records are stored or tracked after exchange is outside this schema.

schema_version.description: Version of the batch schema (semantic versioning, e.g., '1.0.0').

extensions.description: Extension point for batch-level custom fields or plugin data. Keys SHOULD be prefixed with 'x_' or 'custom_' to avoid collision with future standard fields.

collections.description: Array of fully embedded collection records. Each must conform to the Collection schema.
